summary: Rahul (AE) and Anjali Rao (VP Engineering) discussed recent reconciliation pipeline incidents that caused settlement mismatches for merchants. Anjali explained their current monitoring using dbt tests and a Grafana board, and mentioned they are also evaluating Stratify. She indicated the CFO, Vikram, needs to see numbers before approving spend, creating a price objection. Rahul asked to arrange a 30‑minute meeting with the CFO in the next two weeks to present pricing and involve a Solutions Engineer. Anjali agreed to set up the meeting.

objections.text: CFO not sold on the spend.
objections.how_handled: Rahul proposed a meeting with the CFO and to bring pricing
